event_definitions.PRECURSOR_ONLY: BTC resilience + breadth deterioration same transition; 72h cooldown.

interpretation_boundary: Comparator definitions were frozen before this replay, but were not part of original SPAR-v1 preregistration.
All results are feasibility/discovery evidence only.
A stricter P3 identity requires a new prospective experiment identity for any confirmatory claim.
No historical median difference authorizes a market, exit or portfolio rule.
